title: Blackbaud Now Integrates with Intuit Mailchimp to Power More Personalized Nonprofit Engagement
summary: Blackbaud announced at bbcon 2026 that the Blackbaud partner network has expanded to include Intuit Mailchimp.
body_markdown:
*New integration for Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge NXT enables organizations to connect fundraising data with marketing automation to drive stronger donor relationships*


**Charleston, S.C. (October 14, 2026)** — Blackbaud (NASDAQ: BLKB), the world’s leading provider of AI-powered solutions for social impact, announced at bbcon 2026 that the Blackbaud partner network has expanded to include Intuit Mailchimp. The newly launched Mailchimp integration for Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge NXT® helps nonprofits create more personalized communications, strengthen donor engagement, and streamline marketing and fundraising workflows—eliminating the need for customers to pay for separate middleware.


Available now, organizations can seamlessly sync constituent audiences from Raiser’s Edge NXT into Mailchimp, allowing teams to create targeted marketing, stewardship, engagement, and fundraising communications using constituent and giving data from their system of record.


“Nonprofits are increasingly looking for ways to deliver more relevant and personalized experiences to their supporters while maximizing efficiency for their teams,” said Liz Price, Vice President, Global Partners, Blackbaud. “By directly connecting Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge NXT with Mailchimp, organizations can bring together fundraising and marketing data to create more meaningful constituent experiences, automate key engagement workflows, and ultimately strengthen donor relationships.”


With the new integration, organizations can:


- Synchronize selected Raiser’s Edge NXT constituent lists directly into Mailchimp, reducing the need for manual exports and list maintenance.
- Keep marketing and fundraising efforts aligned with the most current constituent information available in Raiser’s Edge NXT.
- Connect directly from Mailchimp using existing Blackbaud credentials through a simple, self-service setup experience so that in Mailchimp Blackbaud customers can:


- Leverage constituent and fundraising data to create more targeted audience segments based on characteristics such as giving history, constituent type, constituency codes, and recurring donor status.
- Trigger automated donor journeys when new constituents are added or gifts are received, supporting welcome series, acknowledgements, stewardship communications, thank-you messages, and future fundraising appeals.


The integration is available at no additional cost for Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge NXT customers. Organizations will need a paid Mailchimp plan and Manager-level access in Mailchimp to use the integration.


##### Availability


The Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge NXT and Mailchimp integration is now available. Access the integration[here](https://app.blackbaud.com/marketplace/applications/822a30f4-7726-48cb-8344-e35b01f0bcf5?appdetails-active-tab=overview) .
